title: Anna babysits
scene: Anna babysits the neighbors' kids. They plan activities: the kids dress up as a pirate and an angel, are afraid of monsters and zombies, play with stickers and glitter, ride the carousel, and at a birthday party a clown brings a pony.

words.ex: We hired a babysitter for Saturday night.
We have many activities for kids.
My son wants to dress up as a pirate.
My son is afraid of monsters.
Do you like watching zombie movies at night?
My daughter put stickers on her notebook.
The kids used glitter on their cards.
The kids rode the carousel at the fair.
We hired a clown for her birthday party.
The kids rode a pony at the farm.
The kids made a collage from old magazines.
My son became a boy scout this year.
He acted like a buffoon at the party.

old_story: On Saturday, Anna is the [[babysitter]] for the neighbors' kids. Lev is eight, and Mila is five. Anna has a list of fun [[activities|activity]] for the day. First Lev dresses up as a [[pirate]], and Mila is an [[angel]]. They play a game about a scary [[monster]] and a slow [[zombie]]. Mila gets scared, so they make cards with [[stickers|sticker]] and [[glitter]]. After lunch, they go to the park and ride the [[carousel]]. Nearby, a [[clown]] gives free rides on a [[pony]]. At home, they make a [[collage]] about their day. Then Lev's big brother comes home in his [[boy scout]] uniform. The kids ask him, "Can Anna come again next Saturday?"

title: Sofia's coming out
scene: Max's sister Sofia tells the family about her coming out: she is queer and introduces her partner. Grandma asks questions about gender and LGBT people, the family talks about stereotypes and taboos, and they learn to show respect.

words.ex: Her coming out surprised no one in her family.
The film tells the story of a queer teenager.
I live with my partner.
Please write your name, age, and gender.
The city holds an LGBT pride parade every June.
Talking about money is a taboo in some families.
Children should show respect to their teachers.
Are there any gay bars near here?

old_story: On Sunday, Max's sister Sofia invites the whole family for dinner. She is nervous, because this dinner is her [[coming out]]. "I am [[queer]]," she says, "and I want you to meet my [[partner]], Dana." For a moment the room is quiet, and then Max gives his sister a big hug. Grandma asks many questions, and Dana kindly explains [[gender]] and what [[LGBT]] means. Dad admits that he believed an old [[stereotype]] from TV. Mom says that in her family, talking about feelings was always a [[taboo]]. "Not in this family," Grandma says, and she pours tea for Dana first. Max raises his glass: "To Sofia and Dana, with love and [[respect]]!"

title: Max's first day at the office
scene: On his first day Max comes to the office, gets a badge from HR and meets his boss, the office manager and the assistant. He learns about the dress code, and the training starts at ten in the meeting room.

words.ex: I work in an office.
Please wear your badge at all times.
Talk to HR about your vacation days.
Ask the office manager for a new key.
Ask my assistant to call you back.
The office has a strict dress code.
The training starts at ten.
Can I book the meeting room for ten o'clock?
Ask the system administrator for a new password.
Ask the admin to reset your password.

old_story: It is Friday, Max's first day at the [[office]]. A woman from [[HR]] gives him a [[badge]]. He meets his [[boss]] and the [[office manager]]. Kate, the [[assistant]], tells him about the [[dress code]]. Max looks down at his old jeans. Kate laughs: "Jeans are OK on Fridays!" At ten, the [[training]] starts in the [[meeting room]]. But Max's computer does not work. The [[administrator]] comes and helps him fast. Max thinks, "I like this new job."

title: A one-on-one with the boss
scene: After three months Max has a one-on-one with his supervisor - his first performance review. They talk about his progress, his potential and his professionalism, the director gives him a bonus, and the good news gives Max a boost.

words.ex: The teacher has a one-on-one meeting with each student.
Ask your supervisor before you leave early.
I have my performance review with my manager on Monday.
You are making good progress in English.
Your son has a lot of potential.
She handled the problem with great professionalism.
Can I talk to the director, please?
I got a bonus at work this year.
The good news gave me a boost.
My boss is very nice.
Can I speak to the manager, please?
The teacher offers one-to-one lessons for new students.

old_story: Max has worked at the office for three months. Today he has a [[one-on-one]] meeting with Ms. Lee, his [[supervisor]]. It is his first [[performance review]], and he feels nervous. Ms. Lee smiles and talks about his [[progress]] on the new project. "You have real [[potential]]," she says. She also likes his [[professionalism]] with difficult clients. Then the [[director]] comes in with an envelope. Inside is a small [[bonus]] for Max! The good news gives him a big [[boost]]. That evening, he buys pizza for Anna and their friends.

title: Sofia works freelance
scene: 'Hey, sis!' - Max visits his sister Sofia, a freelancer who works from home. She writes invoices, plans her week in a calendar and a task manager, follows time management tips, tries career coaching and networking, and keeps a work-life balance.

words.ex: As a freelancer, she works from home.
Please send me the invoice by Friday.
I wrote the meeting on my calendar.
I use a task manager to plan my work week.
Good time management helps students succeed.
She offers career coaching to young managers online.
Networking helped me find my new job.
I need a better work-life balance this year.
She started doing freelance work after she left the office.

old_story: On Saturday, Max visits his sister Sofia and says, "Hey, [[sis]]!" Sofia is a [[freelancer]], and she works from home. Right now she is writing an [[invoice]] for a client. On the wall there is a big [[calendar]] with colorful notes. She plans her week in a [[task manager]] app too. "I read a lot about [[time management]]," she says. Last month she tried career [[coaching]] online. Her coach told her that [[networking]] brings new clients. "But do you ever rest?" Max asks. Sofia laughs and closes her laptop. "For me, [[work-life balance]] is important!"
